R44BB-SURPLUS.result: For every fixed constant surplus s>=1 and width<=3, one exact SAT-preserving variable-eliminating macrostep exists with polynomial state/work; the polynomial exponent may depend on s.
R44BB-SURPLUS.structural_corollary: Any family that is irreducible under these fixed-surplus macros must have unbounded surplus. Since sigma(F)<=d(v)-1 for every variable v, such a family must also have unbounded minimum variable degree.

R44BB-AUTOMORPH.result: For fixed occurrence bound D, a polarity-reversing signed automorphism fixing variable identity x is polynomially detectable and certifies SAT(F) iff SAT(F[x=0]).
